item.description:
Rob Nelson has revealed more info on GTA VI

▪ Shown on PS5 dev kit, but Rockstar says they're "happy" with how it runs on Xbox too. Not ready to talk PS5 Pro enhancements just yet.

▪In a world random event cops are searching for "a furry in the area" in the middle of the night and telling residents to stay indoors.

▪Huge focus on enterable buildings, not everything in the world is enterable, but way more than before. NPC density is high and the world feels natural. Appearances aren't randomized, they reflect who the character is.

▪Car culture is a MASSIVE focus. Customization depth like a full driving game.

▪ TV isn't just ads, they saw a soap opera and a Family Guy like cartoon where every character looks like a dick. Rockstar hired animators to make full episodes.

▪ Rockstar knows some players struggled with RDR2's slower pace. They nailed some role-play elements they want to keep, but say GTAVI needs its own rhythm.
